name: Lexara
author: Stormhand-dev
description: Lexara is a lightweight DLL that replaces WoW 3.3.5's native font renderer with MSDF (Multi-channel Signed Distance Field) technology, delivering sharp, resolution-independent text across the entire game UI — combat numbers, nameplates, tooltips, chat, and more

name: LuxVelum
author: Stormhand-dev
description: A modification for in-game water graphics, sunbeams, and fog.
